Milestones

  1. 2018

    Idea

    A sketchbook, a name and a long weekend.

  2. 2019

    Studio

    First clients and a shared desk.

  3. 2020

    Remote

    Went fully distributed across five time zones.

  4. 2021

    Toolkit

    Published our first open design system.

  5. 2023

    Team of 12

    Hired slowly, kept the culture.

  6. 2024

    B Corp

    Certified, after eighteen months of paperwork.

  7. 2026

    Today

    Fewer projects, better ones.
